if CONFIG["CC_TYPE"] == "clang-cl":
    CFLAGS += [
        "-Wno-inconsistent-dllimport",
        "-Wno-macro-redefined",  # 'WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN' macro redefined
    ]
    CXXFLAGS += ["/EHs", "-Wno-deprecated-declarations"]

    LOCAL_INCLUDES += [
        "/comm/third_party/niwcompat",
    ]

    USE_STATIC_MSVCRT = True
    DEFINES["RNP_USE_STD_REGEX"] = True

    target_cpu = "i386" if CONFIG["TARGET_CPU"] == "x86" else CONFIG["TARGET_CPU"]
    LDFLAGS += [f"clang_rt.builtins-{target_cpu}.lib"]
